verdict.rationale: Gitea's own repository states that it provides an official go-sdk, so the product ships at least one first-party SDK to build against. However, the evidence is a single mention covering only one language. The published OpenAPI/Swagger documents could be used to generate clients, but that is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Go, SDK documentation and usage guides, SDK versioning or support guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
